why_necessary: Retrieved permit text establishes plain-language calendar sampling frequencies (1/Day, 1/Week, 5/Week, 2/Week, 1/Quarter, 2/month) that pair consistently with six of eight code values, but two codes (99/99, 09/99) attach to qualitatively different monitoring modes—continuous totalizing flow and conditional WET retest reporting—whose permit language never uses the opaque code strings and is not reducible to a samples-per-period calendar obligation.
